stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Port and Lake must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Lake and Canal must not occupy consecutive positions." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Hill → Port → Lake → Canal → Valley
- Port → Hill → Lake → Canal → Valley

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "verified_key_agreement"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): Independently enumerated all 120 permutations of Canal, Hill, Lake, Port, Valley. Rules Lake must precede Canal. Canal must precede Valley. Hill and Port must occupy consecutive positions, in either order. Lake must not be in position 1. leave 2 valid orders: Hill>Port>Lake>Canal>Valley; Port>Hill>Lake>Canal>Valley. Choice true counts: a=1, b=0, c=1, d=1; impossible requires zero matches.
